fix_report.what_changed: The workflow is now in scope and the contract requires manual-only, fail-closed behavior with no overwrite option.
The one-shot authority checkpoint now binds repository, candidate commit, tag, assets, digests, and allowed external actions.
The design now supplies a remote-state recovery table that permits only digest-verified missing-asset upload.
The unimplemented output/release copy claim was removed; the Tauri DMG path is the sole upload source.
